body:
So I took about half a gram of MDMA for three consecutive nights each. I didn't have any after effects during the days. Then after the third night of doing so, by the next morning and day I was fine and normal. But by night time I really started getting extremely depressed and feelings of hopelessness. To be honest I couldn't sleep for hours just being depressed.
This has been one of my highest level of depression. When I fell asleep I had vivid and nice dreams; all of which I still remember clearly. Then the next day as I was preoccupied the depression kicked off. But the moment I had nothing to do, my depression hit me again. And this is my 2nd night of depression. So I researched
online. I have exams in three days and am worried that my depression may make me do badly in my exams.
